gate_requirements: Enumerate the exact Swete CTS work for every required Catholic canonical book or addition.
Pin every production XML file by path and Git blob SHA-1 at the locked commit.
Verify work-level metadata and edition identity instead of relying only on repository-level licensing.
Define explicit Catholic-to-source versification mappings, especially Esther and Daniel additions.
Keep CC BY-SA 4.0 material physically and logically separable from non-ShareAlike corpus partitions.
Validate the complete required Catholic Greek inventory before production_import_allowed may become true.
policy: This file is a blocking gate, not a production source manifest. No Septuagint or deuterocanonical Greek text may be served from this candidate source until the exact work/file inventory, Catholic mapping, checksums and owner acceptance are complete.
